description: Re-send a pending invitation email to the invitee and reset its status to Pending. Requires the invite_id (discover it via list of pending invites). The organization is fixed by your context — never pass an organization id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

invite_id.description: Id of the pending invitation to resend.

name: resend_invite
